integrity: No independent external review has occurred; exact formula supported by a reconstructible arch decomposition and binomial-difference proof, plus finite independent semantic checks.
scientific_limitations: Proved for every k>=4 with exactly k+1 of each binary symbol; no claim for more surplus symbols, higher alphabets, or all historical priority. The k=3 case and the unweighted total are already covered by earlier work. Finite verification is not an all-k certificate.
title: A central anti-unimodality notch for balanced near-maximal subsequence universality
